title: Aromatic Resinous Korean Potato Tang
description: A festive Korean dish featuring potato buns cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, served in a copper mug. This satvik-friendly recipe is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, all-purpose flour, and a pinch of salt, and mix well.
Knead the potato mixture for about 10 minutes until it forms a smooth dough.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape to form the potato buns.
Heat the sesame oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and rice vinegar to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the potato buns to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned.
Serve the potato buns in a copper mug, garnished with chopped green onions.
